placements.link_name: Competing US seabed permit applicants racing the same regulatory template
placements.role: A second, publicly listed US seabed-mineral permit applicant racing the same NOAA consolidated-review pathway TMC USA-A pioneered: Deep Sea Minerals Corp's US subsidiary filed its own Clarion-Clipperton Zone exploration-license application under the Deep Seabed Hard Mineral Resources Act, which NOAA determined to be in substantial compliance on June 1, 2026, and the company submitted an amended application on July 17, 2026. This is the first publicly listed name found in this permit race; every entrant found in the chain's own build (Impossible Metals, American Metal Resources/SeaX) is privately held.

role_evidence.claim: the NOAA had determined that application submitted under the DSHMRA is in substantial compliance with applicable U.S. regulatory requirements ... seeks an exploration license for polymetallic nodules in a defined area of the Clarion-Clipperton Zone in the Pacific Ocean
